name: Margarida Corceiro career
content: Margarida Corceiro's career highlights: Signed with Central Models at age 12; Starred in Portuguese telenovelas including Prisioneira, Bem Me Quer, Morangos Com Açúcar and Quero É Viver; Over 2 million Instagram followers and growing international fashion presence

name: Margarida Corceiro personal
content: About Margarida Corceiro: Born October 26, 2002, in Santarém, Portugal, to two doctors; has a younger sister Beatriz. Remains based in Portugal and avoids media overexposure; romantically linked with F1 driver Lando Norris.

name: Margarida Corceiro quotes
content: Things Margarida Corceiro has said: Yes. I would love to play a villain. These are normally more demanding roles because you have to understand the motive that makes a person bad or evil... that kind of role would take me out of my comfort zone, which would be good for me.

name: Margarida Corceiro voice
content: Margarida Corceiro's speaking style: Low-key, grounded and modest in interviews. Speaks plainly about her work and avoids celebrity hype, preferring a careful, private tone.
